duplicate_resolution: FE8J 0x01 and inserted 0x48 are the early Mystery portrait and map to FE8U 0x01.
FE8J tail Mystery 0xAC/0xAE map to FE8U tail Mystery 0xAC; FE8J faded 0xAD maps to FE8U faded 0xAB.
derivation.method: Match complete named portrait table signatures (tileset, palette, blink mode); resolve only duplicate Mystery signatures by named table role and tail placement.

target_overrides.rationale: FE8J provider 0x0B53 uses generic Soldier1, but FE8U target 0x0B93 explicitly loads the Rausten Soldier portrait; target context overrides the generic signature map.
